# Nxtlvl Social

> Nxtlvl Social (Next Level Social) is an AI-driven growth company in India. It provides marketing, business automation, creative production (shoots, video editing, graphic design) and website development to businesses on monthly subscriptions. AI systems handle research, drafts and repetitive work; a human team handles strategy, creative direction and quality, and reviews everything before it goes live.

## Services

- [AI Marketing](https://nxtlvlsocial.ai/ai-marketing): social media management (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube), content strategy, marketing campaigns, Meta and Google Ads, SEO and AEO (answer engine optimisation), analytics and monthly reporting. Ad spend is paid by the client directly to the platform.
- [AI Automation](https://nxtlvlsocial.ai/ai-automation): Instagram and Facebook DM and comment automation, WhatsApp Business automation, lead capture and qualification, CRM and lead tracking, follow-up sequences, booking and reminder flows, with human handover. Built on official Meta and WhatsApp tools.
- [Creative Studio](https://nxtlvlsocial.ai/creative-studio): product and brand photo and video shoots on location, reels and short-form video, video editing, graphic design, brand identity, AI-assisted visuals finished by designers.
- [Website Development](https://nxtlvlsocial.ai/website-development): business websites and landing pages, SEO and AEO setup with schema markup, forms and integrations, analytics, hosting and updates.

## Key facts

- Model: monthly subscription with a written scope; no long contract; change scope, pause or stop at the end of any month.
- Pricing: custom, quoted in writing after a free 20-minute strategy call.
- Ownership: clients own all final files, source files, accounts and systems.
- Approach: AI for speed, people for judgement; nothing is published without client approval.
- Who it serves: D2C and e-commerce, restaurants and cafés, clinics and wellness, real estate, education, startups, creators and personal brands.
- Where: remote-first across India and internationally; shoots on location.
- In development: the Nxtlvl growth platform, an AI workspace that turns a brief into ideas, scripts and reels; subscribers get early access.
- Contact: connect@nxtlvlsocial.ai. Instagram: @ai.nxtlvl (AI and growth), @nxtlvlledits (editing work).
